verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. It also offers bulk exports by type and date range across customers, cases, transactions and profiles. However, the batch capability gets only a single-line mention, and the monitoring configuration and status endpoints are explicitly per-customer, so bulk mutation across many items is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented Batch Processing API details (supported operations, limits, job status), bulk case/alert remediation or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
